RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was neither a barrier to appointment nor the deciding factor between candidates. Bringing up the all-female panel would appear unfounded and could significantly damage your professional reputation.

For a head of department, panels often weigh regulatory liaison and stakeholder management more heavily than pure technical depth; her broad regulatory experience was likely the differentiator over your statistical expertise.

A two-week delay for written feedback is typical corporate bureaucracy, not evidence of bias. Instead of raising panel demographics, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused strictly on skills and competencies to guide your next senior application.
